scripts.android:open: npm run build:app && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:app && cap sync android && node scripts/android-apk.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run build:app && cap sync android && node scripts/android-apk.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:app && node desktop/prepare.mjs && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.build:win: npm run build:app && node desktop/prepare.mjs && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
